abstract: OBJECTIVE: The present study aims to report the preliminary experience with videolaparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in the treatment of patients with non-seminomatous testicular tumor. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Seven surgeries were performed in order to access retroperitoneal lymph nodes in patients with non-seminomatous testicular cancer. We performed the videolaparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (LRL) technique in 5 patients with stage I disease and laparoscopic resection of residual mass (LRRM), following chemotherapy (ChT), in 2 patients with stage II disease. Initial approach was obtained through 4 trocars, using an incision in supra-umbilical midline when manual assistance was required. Surgical time was analyzed, as well as blood loss, need for analgesic drugs postoperatively, hospital stay, complications, need for blood transfusion, histopathological data and tumor control in a mean follow-up of 18 months. RESULTS: Mean surgical time was 200 to 260 minutes in LRL and LRRM groups respectively, mean blood loss was 300 mL for the LRL group and 400 mL for the LRRM group, without need for transfusions. There was a lesion in the vena cava in the LRL group, which was managed with manual assistance and one conversion in the LRRM group, due to a 10-cm tumor mass that was adhered to the aorta. Mean hospital stay was 3 days, excluding the converted case, and the use of analgesic drugs was needed until the second postoperative day. Of the stage I patients, 2 had active disease in retroperitoneum, and underwent adjuvant ChT. The 2 residual masses were teratomas. There was no recurrence during the follow-up period. CONCLUSIONS: Videolaparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy is a procedure with high technical complexity and a higher potential for conversion when performed following chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 目的：非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の治療におけるビデオ腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の予備的経験を報告すること。対象と方法：非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者の後腹膜リンパ節に到達するため、7例の手術を施行した。病期I疾患の5例にはビデオ腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(LRL)法を施行し、化学療法(ChT)後に病期II疾患の2例に腹腔鏡下残存腫瘤切除(LRRM)を施行した。初回の到達は4本のトロカールを用い、人工的な補助が必要な場合には臍上部正中切開を用いた。手術時間、出血量、術後の鎮痛薬使用量、入院期間、合併症、輸血の必要性、病理組織学的データ、および平均18か月の追跡期間における腫瘍制御を解析した。結果：平均手術時間は、LRL群で200分、LRRM群で260分であった。平均出血量はLRL群で300 mL、LRRM群で400 mLであり、輸血は不要であった。LRL群では1例に大静脈の病変がみられ、人工的な補助により対処した。LRRM群では、大動脈に接着した10cmの腫瘤のため1例で開腹移行した。平均入院期間は、移行症例を除き3日であり、鎮痛薬は術後2日目まで必要であった。病期I患者のうち2例は後腹膜に活動性疾患を有しており、補助化学療法を受けた。残存腫瘤2例は奇形腫であった。追跡期間中に再発はみられなかった。結論：ビデオ腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清は技術的に高度に複雑な手技であり、化学療法後に施行した場合には開腹移行の可能性がより高い。
